'''Shawti''' was a prominent<ref name="Trilogy" /> [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|umpassstay|Umpass-stay}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Trilogy" /> located in the [[Shawti system/Legends|Shawti system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="AOC" /> The world was a colony of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|145|Shawti}}</ref> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that dominated Hutt Space,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and used as a site for the reproduction of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Mud [[Bath/Legends|baths]] and a large agricultural [[Unidentified plantation|plantation]] operated by the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]]<ref name="Trilogy" /> [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]<ref name="TEA" /> were present on Shawti. Several Hutt clan leaders were locals of the world.<ref name="Trilogy" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shawti was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a [[1997]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Trilogy" />
